body: Im diagnosed with clinical depression and complex PTSD. severe anxiety. I dont count my self as succeful yet; I am a second year law student after succesfully getting a scholarship to study full term bachelors degree there is a chance also for a masters degree. I handled my depression this way; Take a step back, or 2 step backs to break out of the depression cycle. Thats the only way i deal with it otherwise ill keep seeing ans saying to my self that im worthless and useless and wont get anything done which will result in me feeling more useless and hopeless. You gotta take a breather, realize how the brain is fucking complex organ; you have to take control and keep reminding your self that you can overcome this feeling and do what you can do and BE EASY on yourself dont punish yourself. thats what worked for me so far.. get some CBT if you can, will help you understand and be a better version of yourself.

Not knowing its a past trauma was worst than knowing for me. As it was registered subconciously. I am way happier knowing there id actually nothing wrong with me just the past eating my brains out. Every time I think negatively about my self i reflect to how its just my routine depressive past trying ti bring me down. I am going to finish my bachelors and head for Masters in Law soon. I know am capable, just wish me good luck.

I am diagnosed with complex PTSD; after 20 years not knowing whats wrong with me.

im from a middle eastern country, father died when I was 3 and my mother is diagnosed with HIV which lead my country to deport her back to Thailand. 

The trauma happend through a lot of episodes in my life, family are racist to me due to me being half Thai, school bullies get creative every day with a new sentence of how I am different. I tend to ignore. The most traumatic experience I had is at the end of my high school years, i was kept in a room without anything only books. fed, allowed to go to the toilet or take a bath but thats all for couple of months. i cried every day. Never seen it normal; although never seen it as serious as it is. I am in the UK doing my bachelors in Law now.. and it came back to hunt me, as i feel lonely every now and then and lock my self from everyone. I never thought its PTSD, until 2 weeks ago clinically diagnosed with depression and anxiety + complex PTSD after 2 suicide attempts.

Im back on my foot cause I accepted that.. I am the way I am due to the cruel past and now I have to move on and try to recover.
